description: Read a SLICE of a Czech Statistical Office (ČSÚ) dataset as flat rows (period, indicator, unit, value, one label per dimension), so a figure can be read from datasets too large to export whole (the quarterly wage survey MZDQ1 has 121 million records). Pick the indicator(s) (`indicators`, codes from dataset_detail `ukazatele`, e.g. "5958P" = average gross monthly wage per full-time equivalent employee, CZK), the period(s) (`periods` such as "2026-Q2", or `last_n`; the default is the latest period), and optionally one or more items per dimension (`dimensions`, e.g. {"CZNACEMZDY":["A-S","C"]}). A territory dimension is added automatically (the national total) when none is chosen. For regions and counties use the dataset's territory variant (e.g. "Uz0123vm", items such as "CZ010" Praha) together with the survey variant "ZJIST" ["2"] (workplace method), which is how the wage survey publishes regional figures. Some dimension variants cannot be combined (dataset_detail `pravidlaVyberu.zakazaneKombinace`); an unusable selection is refused with the reason. Version is auto-resolved from the catalog if omitted.

dimensions.description: Item codes to keep per dimension variant, as {"<dimension code>": ["<item>", ...]}, e.g. {"CZNACEMZDY":["A-S"],"KATPMZD":["0"]}. Use an empty array to include every item of that dimension.

indicators.description: Indicator codes (ukazatele), e.g. ["5958P"] average gross monthly wage (CZK). Default: all indicators of the dataset.

kod.description: Dataset id, e.g. "MZDQ1" (quarterly employees and average gross monthly wages). Get it from list_datasets.

lang.description: Accept-Language for labels, "en" (default) or "cs". Most category labels are Czech-only regardless.

last_n.description: Instead of periods: the latest N periods (quarterly "YYYY-Qn" or annual "YYYY" datasets only, max 40).

periods.description: Period item codes of the dataset's time dimension, e.g. ["2026-Q1","2026-Q2"] (quarterly) or ["2025"] (annual). Default: the latest period.

verze.description: Dataset version. Optional, defaults to the latest version from the catalog.

name: czso_cz_get_slice
title: Czso Cz Get Slice
